_doc: Cloudflare accounts Ultrastable runs on. Account ids are not secrets. The API token is never stored here: bind it as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (repo secret or env). Changed by reviewed PR.

target.gate: IC-GATE-001 identity-bound, narrowed 2026-11-14: the connector reaches the account, but no API token for it exists, so GitHub (secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID) and the site worker (CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN) still deploy to the old account. Minting a token is creating a credential in the owner's account. Default in effect: the old account keeps running everything. Closing probe: `python3 scripts/cf_account.py probe` with DST_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN bound reports target_reachable true.
target.name: ultrastable
target.state_detail_2026_11_15: partly running (observed 2026-11-15 via platform connector): ultrastable-site, -tick, -dashboard, -agents and 8 us-idea-* workers and D1 ultrastable-org/-ops exist in this account with ids that differ from doctrine/topology.json; the topology still names the old account, so the cutover is incomplete. platformaudit flags this each run until topology.json and the D1 ids are moved together
target.state_evidence: ops/deploys.jsonl: ultrastable-tick, -dashboard, -site, -agents and -tenants are uploaded to this account by the OIDC route (deploy-ultrastable.yml) with live_matches_commit true on every merge. Zones, 39 KV keys and four workers still in the old account are tracked by OL-20261118-1 (python3 -m foundation singleaccount --moved).
